Please help me with the following task. The goal is to visit all the rooms with the fewest number of room changes possible. In each room, you need to decide the direction to go in. Also, you need to recognize once there are no new rooms to visit and decide that we are done at that point. Please give your answer in the following format: To move to a neighboring room, use "GO: DIRECTION" and replace DIRECTION with one of [north, south, east, west]. To stop the exploration, answer with "DONE" instead. Omit any other text.
Here is an example:
You are in the Kitchen. Currently available directions: south, west. What is your next instruction?
GO: west
You have made a step and entered a Lobby. Currently available directions: east, north. What is your next instruction?
GO: north
...
You have made a step and entered a Bedroom. Currently available directions: south. What is your next instruction?
DONE
Let us start. You are in the Nursery. Currently available directions: south. What is your next instruction?

- Currently in Recreation room with only east direction available, which leads to a previously visited room (Billiard room). No new rooms to visit. All rooms explored. Decision: DONE.
- Currently in Media room with only north direction available, which leads to a new room. To minimize room changes, go north to explore new room.

- Currently in Balcony with directions north, south, west. North leads to a new room, south may lead to a previously visited room, west may lead to a previously visited room. To minimize room changes, go north to explore new room.
- Currently in Billiard room with only south direction available, which leads to a previously visited room. No new rooms to visit. All rooms explored. Decision: DONE.
- Currently in Bar with only west direction available, which leads to a new room. To minimize room changes, go west to explore new room.
- Currently in Game room with directions south, east. East leads to a new room, south may lead to a previously visited room. To minimize room changes, go east to explore new room.
- Currently in Bar with only west direction available, which leads to a previously visited room. No new rooms to visit. All rooms explored. Decision: DONE.
